versions.name: Chesebrough Scout Reservation
versions.address: 26005 Big Basin Way, Los Gatos, CA 95033
versions.summary: A Silicon Valley Monterey Bay Council scout reservation among the redwoods of the Santa Cruz Mountains near Castle Rock State Park, with a training center, campsites, and archery and BB ranges used for council adventures and weekend family and unit camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Silicon Valley Monterey Bay Council camp-properties and Chesebrough camp pages (svmbc.org). The source's Watsonville address (2351 E Lake Ave) was wrong; corrected to the council's listed 26005 Big Basin Way, Los Gatos in the Santa Cruz Mountains. Coordinates geocoded via an OpenStreetMap name match, approximate; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and active operating status verified against the council's own camp pages; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a weekend/family/training reservation (the council's resident summer camp is Hi-Sierra); features unsurveyed.
